name: Website abandonment check for a company domain
description: Website abandonment check for a company domain. Fetches the homepage now and says why it is or isn't serving: hosting billing lapsed (Vercel, Squarespace, Wix), site removed from its platform, CDN origin unreachable, parked or for sale, 410 gone, bot challenge, or serving. For domains Tiag Scovik watches nightly, adds the date the current state began and up to 30 nights of history. Use before paying or onboarding a vendor. GET /abandonment-check?domain=acme.com. $0.01 USDC via x402.
